findings.claim: FY2026 10-K 風險因子：市場技術變化快、新品頻繁推出；光通訊產品已成熟並日趨商品化，傳統對手與亞洲新進者加劇價格壓力，公司需持續開發差異化高階產品。
findings.excerpt: The market for optical communications products in particular has matured over time and these products have increasingly become subject to commoditization. Both legacy competitors as well as new entrants, predominantly Asia-based competitors, have intensified market competition in recent years leading to pricing pressure.
